summary: Reproduced superlinear accumulated CPU time in the checked-out XGrammarGrammar with a real xgrammar GrammarMatcher, then replaced rollback's full-history slice/rebind with guarded in-place truncation. The guard also makes rollback(0) preserve the Python debug history, matching the matcher no-op. Median time for 2,000 to 16,000 committed-token plus speculative accept/rollback iterations changed from 0.005054 to 0.108937 seconds before (21.6x for 8x N) to 0.003257 to 0.025908 seconds after (8.0x for 8x N).

tests.what_was_measured: Pre-fix regression: actual XGrammarGrammar and GrammarMatcher rollback history identity and boundary semantics. Both tests failed as expected; raw output is reports/j-4d59c080bff5/test_before.txt.

Pre-fix controlled host-CPU wall time, five samples per N, for accumulated committed history plus one speculative accept/rollback per iteration on the actual backend. Raw output is reports/j-4d59c080bff5/timing_before.txt.
Post-fix regression: two tests passed, covering in-place rollback and empty, zero, partial, and full-history boundaries with the actual matcher. Raw output is reports/j-4d59c080bff5/test_after.txt.
Post-fix controlled host-CPU wall time under the same five-sample actual-backend workload; doubling ratios were 2.007, 1.978, and 2.004. Raw output is reports/j-4d59c080bff5/timing_after.txt.

gpu_execution.evidence: The focused regression and benchmark instantiate the CPU-side xgrammar matcher and call XGrammarGrammar.accept_token/rollback only; they do not allocate CUDA/HIP tensors or launch GPU work. No GPU performance claim is made.

remaining_limitations: No live speculative-decoding server or model generation was run. The benchmark directly reproduces its reported grammar-state pattern on the checked-out Python backend and installed xgrammar matcher, isolating host rollback complexity from model and GPU variability. This change does not modify native code. Source paths: python/sglang/srt/constrained/xgrammar_backend.py, test/registered/unit/constrained/test_xgrammar_rollback.py, and reports/j-4d59c080bff5/benchmark_xgrammar_rollback.py.
